name: step-pictures
about: A step that read a picture ends its line with it (11 Nov 2026, agents/pictures.rs), as Claude Code's own transcript shows one: in a Bypass Code chat on lab-sandbox that works directly, the session is asked to look at a made-up picture in the workspace. Claude Code hands the picture back in the Read call's own result; Yap keeps a copy with the agent and the stretch's line in the thread ends with it, small. Needs the real Claude Code (a --fake lab's Chat isn't on the plan, so nothing goes directly there).

steps.note: A made-up picture in the scratch workspace: a green triangle on cream.

steps.ask: Look at docs/label.png (read the file itself, it's a picture) and tell me in one sentence what it shows.

steps.note: The picture it read, at the end of its line.
It saw what the picture is (its own words: soft).
